The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.

## Column names

## Recipient measures

Panel reactive antibody classes I and II, and time on dialysis in years: years plus months divided by 12, with a missing month count taken as 0. `strex` takes the first and second numbers from text such as "5 years 4 months".

```{r}
#| label: derive-recipient-measures
#| eval: false
```

## Donor and transplant measures

Donor age in years, warm ischemia time in minutes, and cold ischemia time in hours (hours plus minutes divided by 60). The paper's Supplemental Table 2 labels cold ischemia time in minutes; the values are hours.

```{r}
#| label: derive-donor-measures
#| eval: false
```

## End status

Whether each candidate was transplanted, and from a donor with or without HIV; hepatitis C serology as negative or positive; and panel reactive antibody class II as zero or greater than zero.
